build_mask_rcnn_fpn_model: build a Mask R-CNN model with FPN backbone and ResNet-50 using Detectron2 LazyCall configuration
configure_fpn_backbone: configure an FPN backbone with ResNet-50 bottom-up and LastLevelMaxPool top block
configure_rpn_proposal_generator: configure an RPN proposal generator with default anchor sizes and aspect ratios
configure_standard_roi_heads: configure StandardROIHeads with box and mask heads for 80 class detection
configure_roi_pooler: configure an ROIPooler with ROIAlignV2 for box and mask feature extraction
